factorySection.title: Our Factory
factorySection.paragraph1: VilmoraTex Trading & Industry manufactures fashion apparel and professional uniforms from our own production facility in Egypt. Cutting, sewing, finishing, embroidery, and printing all happen in-house, which means tighter quality control, faster sampling, and pricing that reflects real production cost — not a middleman's markup.
factorySection.paragraph2: We supply retail customers directly and partner with schools, hospitals, hotels, restaurants, and corporate clients on bulk and private label orders across Egypt.

items.title: In-House Manufacturing
items.desc: Cutting, sewing, and finishing all under one roof, so every order is quality-checked at the source.

items.title: Fabric-Accurate Costing
items.desc: We calculate consumption per size, not flat averages — so quotes stay accurate from sample to bulk order.

items.title: Flexible Minimums
items.desc: From boutique private-label trial runs to 1,000+ piece institutional orders, we scale with your business.

items.title: Custom Branding
items.desc: Embroidery, printing, and woven labels applied in-house for a consistent, professional finish.
